about: A cow is a passive mob found in most grassy biomes and is a source of leather , beef , and milk . They have three variants based on the temperature of the biome they spawn in.

An axolotl is a passive aquatic mob found in lush caves that hunts most other aquatic mobs, and can assist players with aquatic combat and grant them Regeneration . They can also be carried around in a bucket .

A creeper is a common hostile mob that quietly approaches a player , hisses, and explodes if the player remains near. Creeper explosions can destroy blocks and deal massive amounts of damage , which can be completely blocked using a shield or blocks.

A warden is a powerful hostile mob summoned by sculk shriekers , which are located in the deep dark . It is completely blind, relying entirely on vibrations and its sense of smell to detect players and entities to attack, and digs down to despawn if it does not detect anything for 60 seconds and is not named . If a warden successfully detects a target, it rapidly strikes them with its arms through melee or fires damaging sonic booms at range which pass through blocks and ignore armor , shields , and all enchantments . Upon death, a warden always drops one sculk catalyst and five experience points .

An enderman is a neutral mob found in all three dimensions that has a chance of dropping ender pearls when it is killed. It becomes hostile to players that damage it or look directly at its face, using its arms to attack. Endermen teleport erratically, as well as away from dangers such as lava , projectiles , and water . They also occasionally pick up and move certain blocks .

A piglin is a neutral mob found in the Nether . It is hostile to players unless they wear at least one piece of golden armor . It can be given gold ingots to barter for various items . It wields either a golden sword , a golden spear , or a crossbow and uses either melee, spear charge, or ranged attacks, respectively.
A spider is a neutral wall-climbing arthropod (arachnid) that attacks players on sight in dark areas by jumping and biting them. Spiders drop string and spider eyes upon death.

Slimes are cube-shaped hostile mobs that spawn deep underground in particular chunks , aboveground in swamps , or when an Oozing -affected entity dies (unless it's a slime). They travel by jumping, chasing after their targets, and usually dealing damage on touch. Slimes spawn in different sizes, and larger ones split into smaller ones on death. Slimes are a major source of slimeballs .

Ghasts are large, floating, ghost -like hostile mobs found in the Nether , and are the only source of ghast tears . Ghasts wander aimlessly and shoot explosive fireballs at players , which can be hit back to kill them instantly upon direct impact.

A shulker is a cubic hostile mob found only in End cities . It hides in its shell to protect itself and blend in with its surroundings, and attacks by shooting homing bullets that inflict Levitation . It is the only source of shulker shells , which are used to craft shulker boxes .

Phantoms are flying undead hostile mobs that spawn in the night sky when the player has not slept in a bed or straw bed for at least 3 in-game days. They attack by diving at the player from the sky to bite them.
